issues.description: The return type of Milkable.messageOnMilk() is inconsistent across the artifacts. The UML block in the problem statement (lines 51-53) defines messageOnMilk():boolean and the textual instruction (line 93) states it should return true/false, while other parts of the UML (e.g. Seal/Goat entries) and the provided solution implement messageOnMilk() as returning String. The solution's Milkable interface declares String messageOnMilk(), and Seal/Goat implementations return String messages. This mismatch would confuse students about whether to implement a boolean or String-returning method and could cause test/compile failures depending on which type they choose.
issues.suggestedFix: Choose a single return type for messageOnMilk() and make all materials consistent. Recommended: update the problem statement UML and the textual description to specify messageOnMilk():String (and give an example like "Goat [name] is milked"), since the solution and class examples already use String. Alternatively, if the intended behavior is boolean, change the solution and examples to return boolean and update method implementations and tests accordingly.

issues.description: The problem statement's UML specifies Milkable.messageOnMilk() with a boolean return type (problem_statement.md lines 51-53) and the textual description also instructs that messageOnMilk() should return true/false. However, the solution implements Milkable.messageOnMilk() as returning a String (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Milkable.java) and the Goat and Seal classes return descriptive Strings. This mismatch (boolean vs String) creates a breaking conceptual/implementation inconsistency: students will be unsure whether to implement messageOnMilk() to return a boolean or a descriptive String, and method signatures will not match between interface specification and provided solution/template usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the specification and implementation for Milkable.messageOnMilk(): either (A) change the problem statement UML and textual description to declare messageOnMilk():String and document that it should return a descriptive message (e.g. "Goat [name] is milked"), matching the solution; or (B) change the solution/interface to messageOnMilk():boolean and update Goat/Seal implementations and any code that prints its result accordingly. Prefer solution (A) if the intent is to print milking messages rather than boolean success flags.
